entities.name: José Aguirre de Achá
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José María Aguirre de Achá was a Bolivian writer, politician and lawyer from Cochabamba. He was active as a lawyer during the 1898 revolution and later served as Minister of Education. He was also a diplomat to Colombia, Venezuela and Ecuador.
